newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY CIB TAPS MKTS FOR $100MLN, LIBOR PLUS 20BPS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY CIB TAPS MKTS FOR $100MLN, LIBOR PLUS 20BPS.

text.p: Hungary's Central European International Bank Ltd (CIB) said on Thursday it signed an agreement to tap markets for a $100 million five-year loan and revolving credit facility.

The loan, jointly arranged by Credit Suisse First Boston and Royal Bank of Canada Europe Ltd, and co-arranged by Bankgesellschaft Berlin and Norddeutsche Landesbank, was oversubscribed but CIB decided not to raise the amount.
The loan is priced at a margin of 20 basis points over LIBOR and a front end fee of 18.5 basis points for the highest participation level, CIB said in a statement.
"This facility sets a new benchmark with respect to Hungarian entities and ensures CIB's status as Hungary's lowest cost borrower," it added.
A total of 17 commercial banks of 11 countries participated in extending the loan, it added.
